stories.title: Little League Classic — Braves 4, Brewers 2 at Williamsport
stories.angle: Atlanta Braves won 4-2 over the Milwaukee Brewers in the 2026 MLB Little League Classic on Sunday night at Journey Bank Ballpark at Historic Bowman Field in Williamsport, Pennsylvania. It was the first Little League Classic appearance for both franchises. Tyler Mahle delivered 5 strong innings, Michael Harris II hit his 21st homer of the season in the ninth, and Raisel Iglesias closed it out for his 27th save. For the Braves — only their second win in seven games despite being NL East leaders — it was a timely victory in a national showcase. For the Brewers (81-49, best record in baseball), it was a minor blip in a dominant season.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Braves 4, Brewers 2 at Williamsport. Mahle goes 5 strong (5-10). Harris hits his 21st HR off Ashby in the 9th. Iglesias records save No. 27. First Little League Classic for both franchises. Braves win just their 2nd of the last 7. Best game all week. #Braves #Brewers

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Jacob Misiorowski — 12-5, 1.75 ERA, 210+ Ks, -550 Cy Young favorite — watched Sunday's Little League Classic from the broadcast booth. The Brewers lost 4-2. His next start will be a completely different story. #Brewers #MLB

stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong NL MVP Race — 32 Games Left
stories.angle: The cold streak headline that dominated the past few days (4-for-36) is real, but at the macro level, PCA's 2026 season remains extraordinary. With 32 games left, he sits at .281/30HR/78RBI/89R/31SB with 7.7 fWAR — the highest WAR among NL position players. The Cubs are 74-56 and hold the No. 1 Wild Card spot. The question now: does the cold streak matter in the MVP conversation, or does the season-long performance reestablish the dominant case when the votes are counted?

x_posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong: .281 BA, 30 HR, 78 RBI, 89 R, 31 SB, 7.7 fWAR. Cubs at 74-56. 32 games left. Yes, there was a cold streak. The season line says what it says. The NL MVP case is still his to lose. #Cubs #NLMVPRace

stories.title: Yordan Alvarez Triple Crown Chase — 32 Games Remain
stories.angle: Thirty-two games remain for Yordan Alvarez to complete the first MLB Triple Crown since Miguel Cabrera in 2012. As of the latest reporting, Alvarez leads the AL in batting average, home runs, and RBIs. In the modern power-strikeout era of baseball, leading all three categories simultaneously — especially batting average — is genuinely rare. The name Cabrera is the relevant benchmark, not Mantle.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text: Yordan Alvarez leads the AL in batting average, home runs, AND RBIs. With ~32 games left, he's chasing the first MLB Triple Crown since Miguel Cabrera won it in 2012. This is genuinely rare. Don't look away. #Astros #TripleCrown

stories.title: Misiorowski Cy Young Case — Brewers 81-49
stories.angle: Jacob Misiorowski did not pitch in Sunday's Little League Classic at Williamsport — he was in the broadcast booth as a featured guest — while the Brewers fell 4-2 to the Braves. That's context, not a setback. Misiorowski at 12-5 with a 1.75 ERA and 210+ strikeouts is the most dominant pitcher in the NL and the heavy Cy Young favorite. Milwaukee is 81-49, the best record in baseball. His next start is a different story entirely.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text: The Cy Young conversation starts and ends with Misiorowski: 12-5, 1.75 ERA, 210+ Ks, -550 odds. Brewers are 81-49, best record in baseball. Whatever happens when he's not pitching doesn't change the argument. #Brewers #CyYoung

stories.title: NL Wild Card Standings — August 24 Update
stories.angle: With approximately 32 games left, the NL Wild Card race has a clear leader in the Cubs (74-56) and two teams in position — Phillies (72-58) and Padres (70-60) — plus the Diamondbacks hovering one game behind San Diego for the final spot. For the Cubs, the priority is maintaining No. 1 seed to avoid a potential first-round series against the Brewers (81-49), who hold the best record in baseball. The race for the third spot is the live competition.
